Policy.description: The step rule of a tool hook (a script a tool row runs to verify its pin): a declared step with a name in both languages, a heartbeat line every `heartbeatMilliseconds` that names the tool, the step and the seconds run of the bound, and a derived `boundMilliseconds` after which the hook is stopped with the typed refusal `ToolHookTimeout`. The bound of `verify` is 1800 s, half of the 3600 s the ready stage may run (attempt A of g1-m05 ended at 3649 s by that timeout): the tectonic verification of g1-m05 on 2026-11-18 ran silently for more than 1200 s and then passed (the whole tools attempt took 1880 s while another build script held the machine), so the bound must not cut a wait that ends, and still names a wait that does not end long before the stage timeout does. The heartbeat is a step line of the ready supervisor (`stepLinePatterns` of the process tree policy): `<tool>: <English> / <German> (<script>): <seconds> of <bound> s;`, so every beat is progress for its stall rule and the step is overdue only after its bound plus the silent window, always after this refusal.

waiting.en: [tools] {tool}: {step} ({script}): {seconds} of {bound} s; its own output is not shown here, the lease and fleet waits it names appear in the log of the command
waiting.de: [tools] {tool}: {step} ({script}): {seconds} von {bound} s; seine eigene Ausgabe wird hier nicht gezeigt, die Lease- und Flottenwartezeiten, die es nennt, stehen im Protokoll des Befehls

timeout.en: The tool {tool} could not be verified: its hook {script} ({step}) did not finish within {bound} s. It is stopped. Check what holds it (repo leases status, the fleet cache answer, an antivirus scan of the new executable) and run repo tools setup again.
timeout.de: Das Werkzeug {tool} konnte nicht geprüft werden: sein Hook {script} ({step}) wurde nicht innerhalb von {bound} s fertig und wurde gestoppt. Prüfen, was ihn hält (repo leases status, Antwort des Flottencaches, Virenscan der neuen ausführbaren Datei), und repo tools setup erneut ausführen.
